# The Stitcher Trilogy

Author: Bartosz Osiej
Genre: Dark literary horror / psychological thriller
Books: English only | Kindle Unlimited | Ebook & hardcover on Amazon

The Stitcher Trilogy is a series of three dark literary horror novels about obsession, silk, and the thin line between art and madness: detective Marcus Delgado discovers a room full of dolls made from human skin and becomes obsessed with the craft of their creation.

## Books

### The Stitcher (Book 1)
A Chicago detective finds Mrs. Harlow surrounded by dolls sewn from human skin — and falls into the obsession herself. Literary thriller in the vein of The Silent Patient meets dark fiction.
- Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHY39314

### The Curator (Book 2)
Pia Redfern inherits a museum collection of impossible, beating shells — and the curator who loves them too much. A blue so deep and vivid it seems to glow from within.
- Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHXT2ZRZ

### The Reckoning (Book 3)
The thread fraying. The ending of the trilogy.
- Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX7CPY7H

## Series tagline
"The thread is fraying. Someone is cutting it."
